status.description: The deterministic exit code. TASK_COMPLETE exists only as status=SUCCESS with all must_haves proven.

worktrunk_path.description: Absolute path of the Git Worktrunk the worker operated in.

commit_hash.description: HEAD commit of the worktree at termination. On FAIL after rollback: the last green commit.

trace_id.description: The X-LiteLLM-Trace-Id for chargeback. Required for gateway-governed engines; null for subscription-governed engines (regime=subscription).

regime.description: The engine's FinOps regime per the Dual FinOps Regime (handbook §6.4).

failure_class.description: Required when status=FAIL; maps to the Failure Taxonomy for ReAct recovery routing.
